note: A group that names neither `axis` nor `axes` used to load as axis-less and drop each member's value and label. The hardest form is this one: flat one-axis members whose `axis` line is missing, which reads like a valid one-axis group. Allowed twin: group-member-shapes-load, whose umbrella declares `axes = []` and whose one-axis group names its axis.
fails_if: the register loader accepts a [[group]] with neither `axis` nor `axes` (an implicit axis-less group) instead of requiring an explicit `axes = []`
